text:
samir: Heads-up — found an AWS access key embedded in a CI artifact stored in S3 (build logs). Likely leaked from a legacy job. Marking this P1. Please advise rotation + containment.
elaine: Which principal/key is it? user or role? any idea blast radius?
samir: Access key starts AKIA...REDACTED (removed here). It maps to `svc-ci-build` user. Seems to have wide S3 + STS permissions. Found in s3://redwood-artifacts/build-1723/logs.tar.gz -> .npmrc contained creds.
mike: Oncall/ops, can you revoke that key ASAP and emit evidence of disablement? I'll prep a rotation plan.
ops-oncall: Disabled access key at 1749324600 — putting disable marker in the ticket. Which services need to pick up replacement creds?
samir: CI runners that upload artifacts + a small internal uploader lambda. We need to: 1) revoke old key 2) provision least-privilege role/creds 3) store creds in Vault (KMS-wrapped) 4) update CI to fetch at runtime 5) enable Vault audit logging on the ci path and preserve logs for forensics.
riley: I can change CI pipeline to use KMS envelope encryption and Vault transit. Plan: a) create IAM role with minimal S3 put/list, b) create STS assume-role for runners, c) write cred metadata to Vault with transit wrap. Also add a lint step to block plaintext keys in repo.
elaine: Also recommend RBAC change: restrict who can create access keys for `svc-ci-build` (only platform-admins). I'll open a terraform PR to change IAM policy to require `iam:CreateAccessKey` be limited.
compliance: Scope check: key only used for internal artifact uploads, no customer data buckets accessed. Still classify as security incident (I-234). Preserve all related logs; legal/ops notified.
samir: Enabling Vault audit for the CI secret path now so we have an immutable audit trail. Command I ran: ```
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit_ci.log log_raw=true
``` 
vault-bot: Audit device enabled at 1749324680
mike: Rotation helper (draft): ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rotate svc-ci-build creds
NEW=$(aws iam create-access-key --user-name svc-ci-build)
ACCESS_ID=$(echo "$NEW" | jq -r .AccessKey.AccessKeyId)
SECRET=$(echo "$NEW" | jq -r .AccessKey.SecretAccessKey)
# write into Vault (KMS-encrypted at rest)
vault kv put secret/ci-build aws_access_key_id=$ACCESS_ID aws_secret_access_key=$SECRET
# update CI to assume new role / fetch from Vault at runtime
``` 
riley: I'll add a pre-commit and runner check to fail pushes that match `AKIA|aws_secret_access_key` or other secret patterns. Also add a CI job that scans open PRs for creds.
ops-oncall: New key created and stored in Vault at `secret/ci-build`. Vault policy updated: `ci-runner` role has read-only access to that path. Rotated lambda env vars updated.
samir: Terraform PR to tighten IAM (restrict CreateAccessKey) opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/132 — requesting review. Created incident I-234 and linked to the ticket with the artifacts.
compliance: Added retention hold and snapshot of S3 artifact for forensic review. Postmortem meeting scheduled 10am PT tomorrow. No customer notification required per scope analysis.
samir: Quick checklist summary in I-234: revoked key, provisioned least-priv role, stored new creds in Vault (KMS), enabled Vault audit, updated CI, added repo/CI scanning. Thanks all — follow-up in postmortem. :thumbsup:
